youtube.title: Why are there two flush buttons on a toilet? #shorts
youtube.description:
Why are there two flush buttons on a toilet? In a dual flush toilet both buttons lift the same plug at the bottom of the tank. So how does dual flush work? Each button also lifts its own little float, and a float holds the plug open only while there's water around it. The moment the water drops below it, the float falls and the plug shuts. The small button's float sits about halfway up, so only about 3 litres go; the big one's sits at the bottom, so the whole tank (about 6 litres) goes. No sensor, no electricity, just floating plastic.
